# FoldClock

`README.md` is the English product description. It is marketing copy. Behavior lives in this file.

`:app` (`com.kitchen.clock`) is a foldable night clock. `compileSdk` is 37 because `core-ktx` 1.19.1 and lifecycle 2.11 require it. `targetSdk` stays 36. `minSdk` is 31. Java toolchain is 11.

Do not change `ui/theme/Theme.kt`, color resources, launcher icons, or the Gradle wrapper.

## Behavior

- Night light hysteresis lives only in `domain/UpdateNightLight` and uses the hinge angle: `null` keeps the previous value, `>= 36` (20% of 180°) turns the inner display on, `<= 27` (15%) turns it off, otherwise keep the previous value. `domain` has no `android.*` imports.
- Hinge angle comes from `Sensor.TYPE_HINGE_ANGLE` when that sensor exists. Otherwise `FoldingFeature` maps to `180` (`FLAT`), `90` (`HALF_OPENED`), or `0` (no fold). `FoldStateRepositoryImpl` applies the use case with `scan`, seeded from `SavedStateHandle` key `night_light_on`.
- The clock flow uses `java.time`, emits on `Dispatchers.Default`, waits until the next minute, and also collects `ACTION_TIME_CHANGED`, `ACTION_TIMEZONE_CHANGED`, and `ACTION_DATE_CHANGED`.
- Burn-in offset is `minuteOfDay / 2 % 4` → `(8,0), (0,8), (-8,0), (0,-8)` dp.
- Rear display uses `androidx.window:window:1.5.1` (`presentContentOnWindowArea`, `transferActivityToWindowArea`, `WindowAreaSession.close()`). Do not move to 1.6: that release renames transfer and drops the session.
- Capability priority while the lid is closed: present `AVAILABLE` or `ACTIVE` → `DualScreen`; else transfer `AVAILABLE` or `ACTIVE` → `RearTransfer`; else `SingleScreen`. Call present or transfer only when status is `AVAILABLE`.
- While the lid is open (`isOpenedEnough`, the 20%/15% angle gate), `displayMode` forces `DualScreen` even if transfer is `AVAILABLE` or `ACTIVE`. Transfer blanks the inner display. While the lid is closed, `displayMode` selects `RearTransfer` when `transferPossible` (transfer `AVAILABLE` or `ACTIVE`) so the inner panel turns off; present is not kept. If transfer is impossible, the closed lid selects `SingleScreen`. An active transfer session is closed first, and present is not started until transfer leaves `ACTIVE`. A rejected transfer does not block a later present.
- An in-flight rear start stays guarded until its callback. `close()` or an op change in that window bumps the request generation and does not call `transferActivityToWindowArea` / `presentContentOnWindowArea` again. `IllegalStateException` from those calls is caught and held until the capability leaves `AVAILABLE`/`ACTIVE` or `getActiveSession()` adopts an `ACTIVE` session. A start that ends before `onSessionStarted` — the system rear-display dialog was dismissed — is held the same way (`start dismissed`) and must not be started again while that capability stays `AVAILABLE`/`ACTIVE`. If `close()` already cleared `desiredOp` because the dialog paused the activity, `finishCancelled` uses that same hold so the next `sync` does not reopen the dialog. Adopt an `ACTIVE` session when this gateway has no session object.
- Cold start of the activity window plays `StartupGlow` once: a gold field fills the screen and, over 1 second (`t^1.5`), shrinks into the launcher clock mark at the center, then the overlay fades. Progress is a `mutableFloatStateOf` read only inside `onDrawBehind`. The cover `ComposeView` does not play it. Touches are consumed until it finishes.
- The activity window background is the night-lamp color only when `activityShowsNightLight` is true: the angle gate is on, this window is the inner display (`FoldingFeature` is present), and the mode is not `RearTransfer`. The color comes from `DisplayLook.nightPalette(innerHueDegrees)` (default hue is `#FF8C00`). `NightLightScreen` draws slow water caustics in that palette (`RuntimeShader` on API 33+, sine ribbons on API 31–32); deep and bright colors are shader uniforms. Frame time is elapsed nanos from the first frame, written by `withFrameNanos`, and read only inside `onDrawBehind`. Otherwise that window draws the clock, including while the angle is still below the gate and while it is the external screen. The cover `ComposeView` always draws the clock. `currentOnInnerDisplay` reads `getCurrentWindowLayoutInfo` (extension 9+) only while the window is attached to a valid display; null means unknown. A snapshot may set the inner display on, and it never clears it. The layout flow clears it, unless a fresh snapshot is still true. A flow `true` is dropped when that snapshot is false.
- Orientation is not locked. The manifest has no `screenOrientation`, and neither window sets `requestedOrientation` or `LayoutParams.screenOrientation`. Both displays follow the gyroscope. Fullscreen chrome (hidden system bars, `decorFitsSystemWindows` false, cutout `always`) still applies to both windows.
- `RearTransfer`: the activity window moves to the cover and draws the clock. Do not draw orange; transfer does not create a second surface.
- Both windows use `FoldClockUiState.externalBrightness` (`DisplayLook`, 0.05..1, default 0.7, `SavedStateHandle` key `external_brightness`), including the activity window while it is the night light. Do not pin that window to `BRIGHTNESS_OVERRIDE_FULL`: the inner panel's backlight is `OverrideBrightnessStrategy` from this activity, and the outer panel is `FollowerBrightnessStrategy` of the inner one, so a full override holds both at the top of their range. `FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON` is set on the activity window and `presenter.window`.
- `ExitAppButton` is drawn in the top-end corner of the night-light window and inside `CoverClockScreen`. The glyph is white at alpha 0.5. A tap calls `Activity.finish()`. The button follows the burn-in offset. On the external clock, brightness, color, and exit start visible, fade out after 3 seconds, and return on any press until the finger lifts from a scale; then the 3 seconds start again. Hidden controls do not take touches.
- Inner lamp hue is `innerHueDegrees` (`SavedStateHandle` key `inner_hue`). When the cover window is at least as wide as it is tall, the row is unchanged: brightness and color icons, then the large time and capitalized date, then `monthTitle` (`LLLL yyyy`) and the month grid. When the window is taller than it is wide, the time and date sit above the month grid, the exit button stays in the top-end corner, and the brightness and color icons sit in a row along the bottom. Today is an outline circle. Weekday labels are uppercase short names. Press-drag on an icon shows a scale under the finger until release: vertical when the window is wide (drag up increases the value), horizontal when the window is tall (drag right increases the value). Brightness changes the external display. Hue changes the inner lamp only.
- One `FoldClockViewModel` lives in the activity `ViewModelStore`. `ActivityAnchor.bind` points that retained graph at the current activity so a recreated activity does not sync a second gateway. `onStop` / `onDestroy` call idempotent `close()` only while that activity is still bound.
- `RearArea.canPresent` / `canTransfer` are collected separately from the clock state so a session that ends while the mode stays `DualScreen` is started again when the capability returns to `AVAILABLE`.
- Manifest `configChanges` is `screenLayout|smallestScreenSize|screenSize|orientation`.
- New Kotlin comments are a single Russian line.

## Check

`:app:testDebugUnitTest` covers `UpdateNightLight` boundaries. Fold, time-zone, and rear-display behavior need a foldable emulator.
